work_relations.note: Miyazaki frequently cites this as an influence for his heroines, particularly the theme of a young girl navigating a strange, logic-defying world and discovering her inner strength.

Critics frequently compare Mei's discovery of Totoro by following smaller spirits down a tunnel of roots to Alice following the White Rabbit down the rabbit hole, both initiating a journey into a hidden, magical world.

places.connection: Houses the original manuscript of Alice's Adventures in Wonderland, handwritten and illustrated by Lewis Carroll.
Lewis Carroll (Charles Dodgson) was a mathematics lecturer here, and the location inspired many elements of the story.
The story was first told by Lewis Carroll during a boat trip on the River Thames with Alice Liddell and her sisters.
Alice Liddell, the inspiration for Alice, spent holidays here, and the town has several attractions dedicated to the story.
Lewis Carroll spent time in Guildford, and the castle grounds are said to have inspired some elements of Wonderland.
